title: Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage — Patient Pay Deduction Schedule by Tier
content:
Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, each tier fixes which amounts are kept back from the resident's monthly income before patient pay is figured. The schedule below states those tier settings; the figures on a particular case (the allowance amounts on the County Assistance Office notice or worksheet, the premiums on the case) come from the case itself.

## Tier settings

| Tier | Entry to the tier | Personal needs allowance (USD a month) | Protected VA pension (USD a month) | Community spouse allowance deducted | Dependent family allowance deducted | Home maintenance allowance deducted | Home maintenance maximum months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Standard Patient Pay | no spouse and no dependents in the community | 45.00 | 0.00 | no | no | no | 0 |
| Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Community Spouse Allowance | a spouse in the community | 45.00 | 0.00 | yes | no | no | 0 |
| Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Dependent Family Allowance | no spouse, dependents in the community | 45.00 | 0.00 | no | yes | no | 0 |
| Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, VA Reduced Pension | a VA pension reduced to the protected amount | 45.00 | 90.00 | no | no | no | 0 |
| Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Home Maintenance Allowance | a physician-certified likely return home within 6 months | 45.00 | 0.00 | no | no | yes | 6 |
| Medical Assistance Hospice Room and Board | a hospice election on file | 45.00 | 0.00 | no | no | no | 0 |

## Settings shared by every tier

- **Health insurance premiums.** On every tier, the health insurance premiums the resident pays (Medicare Part B, Part D, Medigap) are deducted when patient pay is estimated.
- **Basis of the estimate.** On every tier, estimated patient pay while an application is pending is income on the application less allowances.
- **Rounding.** On every tier, estimated and partial-month patient pay are rounded half up to the cent.

## Notes on the columns

- The personal needs allowance is what the resident keeps from monthly income under the Pennsylvania Medical Assistance post-eligibility rules: 45.00 dollars a month on all six tiers.
- The protected VA pension is the VA pension amount excluded from patient pay for a resident whose VA pension is reduced under 38 U.S.C. 5503(d): 90.00 dollars a month on the VA Reduced Pension tier and 0.00 on the other five tiers.
- A "yes" means the allowance recorded on the case for that kind of allowance is deducted on that tier; a "no" means it is not deducted on that tier.
- The home maintenance maximum is the number of months for which a home maintenance allowance may be deducted once a physician certifies a likely return home: 6 months on the Home Maintenance Allowance tier, 0 on every other tier.

## Reading the schedule

*Which tiers deduct an allowance beyond the personal needs allowance, premiums and the VA amount?* The Community Spouse Allowance tier (the community spouse allowance), the Dependent Family Allowance tier (the dependent family allowance) and the Home Maintenance Allowance tier (the home maintenance allowance, for no more than 6 months). The Standard Patient Pay, VA Reduced Pension and Hospice Room and Board tiers deduct none of the three.

*Does the VA tier keep back a different personal needs allowance?* No. Every tier keeps back 45.00 dollars; the VA Reduced Pension tier additionally excludes 90.00 dollars of protected pension.
